findings.summary: ball/cage: synthetic-only, uncalibrated amplitude. The ball and cage classes were trained on simulated faults whose mechanical amplitude (CALIBRATED_MECHANICAL_SEVERITY in datagen/scenario.py) is a placeholder: KAt has no clean single-defect code for these faults, so it cannot be calibrated without real data.
Cage faults are almost never recognized below the nominal speed range: cage recall 0.01 at 100 rad/s and 0.05 at 115 rad/s (held-out simulated conditions); the missed cage windows are called ball.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (5-class speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid). Recorded test accuracy 0.821; no real-machine validation exists.
